maddeler.e:
استلقيت (form X)
# اِسْتَلْقَيْتُ (istalqaytu) /is.tal.qaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَلْقَى (istalqā)
# اِسْتَلْقَيْتَ (istalqayta) /is.tal.qaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَلْقَى (istalqā)
# اِسْتَلْقَيْتِ (istalqayti) /is.tal.qaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَلْقَى (istalqā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
